definition: OMIM #621295 designates cerebral arteriopathy, autosomal recessive, with subcortical infarcts and leukoencephalopathy 1 (CARASIL1), a hereditary cerebral small vessel disease caused by biallelic variants in the NOTCH3 gene.

source.title: CADASIL type 1 with cysteine-sparing P572L mutation on exon 11 presenting as focal onset epilepsy: a case report
source.quote: Beyond CADASIL type 1, NOTCH3 mutations are associated with a range of other … arteriopathy autosomal recessive with subcortical infarcts and leukoencephalopathy (OMIM #621295)
